program: SkyraSoft HBOS Retail Platform & Workforce Integrity Program

branch_schema_fields.description: Short code, unique within tenant business

cardinality_architecture.rationale: Supports multiple managers per branch and managers assigned to multiple branches without rigid single manager_id schema column

branch_code_uniqueness.cross_tenant_test: PASSED: Tenant A and Tenant B may both use 'STORE-01' without collision
branch_code_uniqueness.same_tenant_test: PASSED: Tenant A cannot create duplicate 'STORE-01'

branch_creation_pipeline: 1. Authorize calling actor possesses 'manage branches' or is Business Owner
2. Scope business_id from active business context (never trust spoofed payload)
5. Automatically attach creating user to branch_user pivot with business_id
6. Initialize default cash drawer account if financial module is enabled
7. Log branch creation audit event with actor causer attribution

inventory_initialization_strategy.rationale: Avoids eager creation of thousands of zero-balance rows across entire catalog; records are spawned dynamically upon stock receipt/transfer or first count

deactivation_and_deletion_safety.primary_branch_protection: Deactivating or deleting the primary branch without explicit replacement is prohibited (HTTP 422)
deactivation_and_deletion_safety.history_preservation: Deactivated branches retain all historical sales, inventory movements, financial ledger entries, and staff memberships. Hard deletion of operational branches is blocked
deactivation_and_deletion_safety.operational_restriction: Inactive branches reject new sales creation, stock receipts, and inventory adjustments
